Created mcp-server/src/storage/repository-registry.ts: plain-function module with loadRegistry(), saveRegistry(), findByFolderName(), and getAllFolderNames() following the atomicWriteJson/withLock pattern used throughout the codebase.
loadRegistry() returns { repositories: [] } on absent file, malformed JSON, or schema validation failure — all three error paths silently degrade to an empty registry.
saveRegistry() validates via RepositoryRegistrySchema before acquiring a withLock(ledgerRoot, ...) lock and calling atomicWriteJson — matching the existing locking strategy.
findByFolderName() is a pure synchronous lookup (no I/O) iterating over folder_names with Array.prototype.includes.
getAllFolderNames() returns a defensive copy to prevent callers from mutating the entry's folder_names array.

Created mcp-server/gui/api-repos.ts: domain-split handler module following the api-knowledge.ts pattern, exporting handleListRepos, handleGetRepo, handleCreateRepo, handleUpdateRepo, handleDeleteRepo.
handleListRepos: loads registry via loadRegistry(), maps entries to RepoListItem shape (id, label, folder_names, has_vision, created_at, last_modified). Returns [] on empty/absent registry.
handleGetRepo: loads registry, finds entry by id, throws NOT_FOUND (404) for unknown repoId.

handleCreateRepo: validates body via RepoCreateBodySchema (Zod .strict()), enforces id uniqueness, enforces folder_name uniqueness via assertNoFolderNameConflicts(), defaults vision to all-null, persists via saveRegistry(). Returns 201 with the new entry.

handleUpdateRepo: loads registry, checks NOT_FOUND, validates body via RepoUpdateBodySchema (.strict()), enforces folder_name uniqueness excluding the entry being updated (self-conflict allowed), merges partial updates, sets last_modified. Persists via saveRegistry().
handleDeleteRepo: loads registry, checks NOT_FOUND, filters out the entry, persists. Returns { deleted: true }. Does NOT delete any project files.
